## CAPITOL FEDERAL FINANCIAL, INC.® ANNOUNCES ANNUAL STOCKHOLDERS MEETING DATE


October 16, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/432542075/files/doc_news/CAPITOL-FEDERAL-FINANCIAL-INC--ANNOUNCES-ANNUAL-STOCKHOLDERS-MEETING-DATE-2026.pdf)


TOPEKA, Kan.


, Oct. 16, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Capitol Federal Financial, Inc. (NASDAQ: CFFN) (the "Company") announced today that the annual meeting of stockholders will be held on Tuesday, January 26, 2027. The voting record date will be December 4, 2026.


Capitol Federal Financial, Inc. is the holding company for Capitol Federal Savings Bank (the "Bank"). News and other information about the Company can be found at the Bank's website,[https://ir.capfed.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4799207-1&h=2729638354&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.capfed.com%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Fir.capfed.com) .
